issues.where: f0528-f0539, rain around the canopy and above the puddle at lower left
issues.what: The rain reads mainly as parallel streaks. The sheets show few clear contacts with the leaves or the puddle, so the downpour looks less grounded than the plant motion.
issues.fix: Show a few distinct drops striking and breaking on leaf edges and sending out small, irregular ripples where they hit the puddle.
